critical.issue: LADDER DRIFT — /next-bid imports get_minimum_increment from shared.py (12-tier ladder using field `increment_type`) but /increment-info imports get_minimum_increment_tiered from utils.py (8-tier ladder using field `increment_option`). Spec explicitly names utils.py as the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. At current=$50 tiered, /next-bid returns step=$2.50 with suggestions=[52.5, 55, 57.5]; utils.py says step=$5 for the $0-$99.99 tier displayed in the Bid Increment Table. Same drift at current=$100 ($5 vs $10). This means Quick Bid pills DISAGREE with the Bid Increment Table shown to the buyer — buyer sees +$5 promised but the pill jumps by +$2.50. Fix: change routes/misc.py line 16 to import `get_minimum_increment` from `utils` (or delete shared.py's copy and re-import). Test confirms the drift via xfail marker in /app/backend/tests/test_iter368_live.py::test_next_bid_ladder_drift_bug_documented.

ui_bugs.issue: Scroll NOT restored on grid return. When 'Back to grid' navigates to /lots/{id}?lot=N, the URL carries ?lot=N which triggers the scrollIntoView(target) branch (priority 1) INSTEAD of the sessionStorage scrollY restore branch (priority 2). Result: window.scrollY resets to 0. Spec explicitly requires 'window.scrollY should be near 800 (within 100px)' AND sort='most_bids' both preserved simultaneously. Currently only sort is restored (from savedState.lotSort setter above). File: /app/frontend/src/pages/MultiItemListingDetailPage.js lines 231-257. Recommended fix: when savedState.scrollY exists AND targetLotNum matches savedState-implied lot, prefer scrollY over scrollIntoView; OR add a check to skip scrollIntoView when a savedState snapshot is being consumed.

rca of the issue: Ladder drift RCA: routes/misc.py imports `get_minimum_increment` from shared.py (line 16 of the imports block) while the /increment-info handler imports the tiered/simplified builders from utils.py (line 940, inside the function). shared.py has its own get_minimum_increment_tiered with a 12-tier ladder (added independently of utils.py). Fix: change misc.py's `get_minimum_increment` import to come from utils; ideally delete shared.py's copy and re-export from utils. Scroll restore RCA: fetchListing sees `targetLotNum != null` (from ?lot=1 in the back-to-grid URL) and takes the scrollIntoView branch on line 246-250. The scrollY restore branch (line 251-257) is `else if`, so it never fires. The savedState IS consumed on the lotSort/viewMode setters above, but the scrollY portion is silently ignored. Fix: reverse priority — if savedState.scrollY exists, use it; only fall back to scrollIntoView when no snapshot.
